title: Punch List Reopen Frequency
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:punchlist room=* reopened=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(reopened="yes",1,0))) as matched by room
| eval a_reopened_item_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_reopened_item_pct
description: Measures the percentage of closed punch-list items that end with a reopened item by room.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which room are helping or hurting closed punch-list items.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a reopened item` on `reno:punchlist` events and summarize the hit rate by `room`.
visualization: Table of room with percentage of closed punch-list items ending with a reopened item.
grandmaExplanation: It records how often a reopened item happens for each room so you can see where closed punch-list items go smoothly or get stuck.
